60-N-T-10.foot_frame: the foot body's frame at home (world-aligned)

75-M-H-10.foot_frame: the foot body's frame at home (world-aligned)

F1 bob.range: 50-100 % of the enforced stance-leg shortening (0.007-0.014 H nominal, 0.013-0.026 H at the animal pace)
F1 bob.rule: bob = 0.75 (duty stride / 2)^2 / (2 (1 - crouch) H) with V0's duty and stride at that speed

F1 bob_phase.range: hips at today's height at mid single support

F3 swing_time.range: the animal-pace walk's swing time, 0.32 s at 60 cm and 0.36 s at 75 cm
F3 swing_time.rule: (1 - envelope.FAST.duty) x the Froude 0.05 walk's period on the body

F5 toe_off_margin.rule: the roll waits until the ZMP reference is 5 mm inside the rolling support (the trailing toe pad's front edge and the leading foot's pads)

F6 roll_amp.rule: toward the stance leg at its mid-stance (V4); V4L the other way

F9 tail_phase.range: the phase minimising the stance foot's yaw moment
F9 tail_phase.rule: tail_check on V4 per body and speed: the peak |M_z| of the single-support stance pad

F13 stride_rel.range: 0.85-0.90 H at the animal pace, 75 cm only

F14 tail_var.rule: the tail amplitude drifts over F9's 0.10-0.15 rad (0.125 +- 20 %)

zmp_iters.rule: look rungs (V1 on) run 12 multibody-ZMP correction passes: the bob and the toe-off slow the convergence (60-N-T-10 animal-pace V3: 3.2 mm after 6, 1.9 mm after 12; V0 1.95 mm after 6)

v040.rule: the gait the brisk_to_fr05 speed change passes through at 0.40 m/s: period, duty and lift mixed with the speed's weight (transitions.py)

stage1_sources.rule: sha256 over designlab/stage1/*.py in path order, each file as its path relative to the package, a NUL byte, its bytes and a NUL byte

note: kinematic references with perfect tracking; priced by the Stage 0 screen before rendering; nothing adopted (P24)
